prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1090; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in League City, Texas, when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, whose vehicle entered the intersection from a crossing street. The point of impact and the resulting damage to both vehicles are consistent with a side impact of this type. Driver 1 reported a knee injury at the scene and said the knee struck the interior of the door during the collision. This account is consistent with the force and direction of the impact as observed. Driver 2 gave a statement that matches the sequence described by Driver 1, and two independent witnesses gave accounts that agree on the order of events. Photographs taken at the scene show damage consistent with the reported impact, and no prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to officers or noted in the records reviewed. A passenger was present in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision, and both officers and witnesses confirmed that Driver 1 was in the vehicle when it was struck. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the applicable policy.
